title: Python Multiprocessing Workers Occasionally Return Incomplete Results When Processing Large Datasets
author: benstokes
Paddy3118
text: Hmm, my initial thoughts are on the line of: If the data/intermediate data is assumed to be different but is not, and set/dict keys are involved, (including True/False/int/float of integer having same hash); then infrequent dualities might be more likely to occur with the larger dataset.
